sentences.text: The spreadsheet says mortality stayed under five percent, but she recounts the sea stars anyway, twice. You learn fast that neoprene gloves do nothing against an urchin spine driven under the thumbnail. Frozen squid thawed in a bucket by the sink, and the whole room smelled of it for hours. Check the sump before you leave — if the float valve sticks again, we'll flood the whole wet lab by midnight. Does anyone know why the header line to the fish room is spitting air? Three flumes, twelve fish per flume, one grad student who hasn't slept since the trial began. Wasn't the flow meter on line two supposed to be replaced last quarter? Under red headlamps we counted pluteus larvae on the hemocytometer until our eyes burned. "Hand me the turkey baster," she said, "the brine shrimp are clumping in the corner again." We calibrated the dissolved-oxygen probe twice; it still read a full milligram low against the Winkler titration. Formally, protocol requires two people present whenever anesthetized rockfish are moved between the surgery bench and the recovery troughs. During spawning induction, the potassium chloride injections sent gametes streaming from the urchins within ninety seconds. Her thesis lives or dies on whether these thirty juvenile sablefish keep eating through the temperature ramp. Somebody left the standpipe out of raceway three again, so the sculpins spent the night in six centimeters of water. Crews who lased the wrong target got a red flag and a long afternoon of remedial drills. Column speed held at fifteen kph, per the safety brief, while the guns worked left to right. A tracer skipped off the hardpan and tumbled, glowing, into the impact area beyond the targets. "Cease fire, cease fire — misfire procedures, now," barked the master gunner, already sprinting down the catwalk. Every rut sent the gunner's sight picture jittering until the stabilization caught up with the terrain. On the net, someone's mic stuck open, broadcasting two minutes of turbine whine to the whole company. What is the meaning of the word tank?
